svg.aria-label: Elephant Tracks. AUSD read a balanced net flow of plus 2.1 percent across 800 swaps. Split by maker, one wallet is 62.0 percent of the sell side — 25,459,824 dollars in 12 swaps — against 212 buying wallets whose largest is 11.7 percent. One grey bar separates into a sell row dominated by a single amber block and a buy row of many small blue ones.
svg.title: Elephant Tracks — net flow read balanced; one wallet was 62.0% of the sell side
